attempts.text:
**The window opens on a short spine.** Columns 0 to 1, `rbbA` to `yhhJ`, are carried by 97 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99.6 to 99.8% of them, fewest at column 1, `yhhJ`, 99.6%.

**The first fork is at `yhhI`**, column 2, carried by 43%, the most plastic stretch of the window. Then the `nik` genes, columns 4 to 9, [[nickel import and transport]], carried by 96 to 97%. Through columns 57 to 59 a branch of 3 shell families runs in 15 to 36%, [[phosphate transport]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 95 against 91%, and hesitates less there, 0.14 against 0.26 bits. It hesitates most at column 2, `yhhI`, a fork column, 1.15 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 57 to 79 are carried by 36 to 89% of chromosomes, 22 persistent and 1 shell. The last column is `pckA`, in 36% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 93% of genes**, 0.18 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.52 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 82% against 94%.

label: rbbA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the rbbA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor rbbA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 236 to 315 from dnaA. Read in 534 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying rbbA once); 42,720 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.18 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,684 calls, named 96%, 0.10 bits; shell 6,864 calls, named 82%, 0.59 bits; cloud 172 calls, named 45%, 1.09 bits. Outside an RGP 39,275 calls, named 94%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 3,445 calls, named 82%, 0.52 bits. Columns: 50 spine, 8 fork, 22 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.52 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (82% against 94%); 3,445 of the 42,720 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 2 (yhhI, a fork column) 1.15 bits, RGP 23%; column 4 (nikR, a spine column) 0.56 bits, RGP 23%; column 3 (yhhH, a fork column) 0.54 bits, RGP 23%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 50 spine columns: named 95%, 0.14 bits on average; the 30 fork and variable columns: named 91%, 0.26 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 2, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 2-3 (fork), RGP 23%; the least: columns 0-1 (spine), RGP 0%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-1 (2 columns) spine: share 97-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: rbbA, yhhJ "ABC transporter permease". named 99.6-99.8% (mean 99.7%), fewest named at column 1 (yhhJ), named 99.6%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.05 bits (column 0 (rbbA)).
[S2] 2. columns 2-3 (2 columns) fork: share 43-46%, all S, RGP 23%. named 73-84% (mean 78%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 2, named 73%, 1.15 bits.
[S2.c2]    2: yhhI S 43% "ISAs1 family transposase"; also "IS1 family transposase" S 22%, hicA S 21%, gatY S 16%
[S2.c3]    3: yhhH S 46% "protein YhhH"; also hicB S 25%, "HPr family phosphocarrier protein" S 16%
[S3] 3. columns 4-10 (7 columns) spine: share 96-97%, all P, RGP 7-23%. Genes: nikR, nikE, nikD, nikC "nickel ABC transporter permease sub…", nikB, nikA, acpT. named 82-99% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (nikR), named 82%, 0.56 bits.
[S4] 4. column 11 variable: share 3%, all P, RGP 4%. named 96%; 0.08 bits.
[S4.c11]    11: rsmJ P 3%
[S5] 5. columns 12-39 (28 columns) spine: share 94-97%, all P, RGP 1-11%. Genes: yhhT "AI-2E family transporter", yhhS "MFS transporter", dcrB, yhhQ "7-cyano-7-deazaguanine/7-aminomethy…", tusA, zntA, yhhN "lysoplasmalogenase", yhhM "DUF2500 domain-containing protein", yhhL "DUF1145 family protein", rsmD, ftsY, ftsE "cell division ATP-binding protein F…", ftsX, rpoH, livJ, panM, livK, livH "high-affinity branched-chain amino…", livM, livG, livF, ugpB, ugpA "sn-glycerol-3-phosphate ABC transpo…", ugpE, ugpC, ugpQ, yhhA "DUF2756 family protein", ggt. named 70-99% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 26 (livJ), named 70%; most hesitant at column 39 (ggt), 0.37 bits.
[S6] 6. columns 40-43 (4 columns) variable: share 57-73%, all S, RGP 3%. named 90-95% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 41, named 90%, 0.47 bits.
[S6.c40]    40: yrhB S 73% "YrhB family protein"
[S6.c41]    41: yrhD S 57% "protein YrhD"
[S6.c42]    42: yrhA S 70% "protein YrhA"
[S6.c43]    43: tssD S 67%
[S7] 7. columns 44-56 (13 columns) spine: share 93-97%, all P, RGP 1-18%. Genes: yhhY "N-acetyltransferase", yhhX "oxidoreductase", yhhW "quercetin 2,3-dioxygenase", gntR "gluconate operon transcriptional re…", gntK, gntU, yhgN "NAAT family transporter YhgN", asd, glgB, glgX, glgC, glgA "glycogen synthase GlgA", glgP. named 91-98% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 56 (glgP), named 91%, 0.42 bits.
[S8] 8. columns 57-79 (23 columns) fork and variable columns: share 36-89%, 22 P, 1 S, RGP 2-23%. named 76-96% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 65, named 76%; most hesitant at column 57, 0.47 bits.
[S8.b57]    a second branch of 3 families through columns 57-59, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 15-36%, all S; the branch's families: "PstS family phosphate ABC transporter s…", "PstS family phosphate ABC transporter s…", "hypothetical protein"
[S8.c57]    57 fork: glpD P 89%; also "YbbD family protein" S 27%, "fimbrial biogenesis usher protein" S 14%
